policy.identity: same task/agent/conversation; preserve explicit initial and latest follow-up directives even when context reads fail
policy.parent_scope: only authorized hierarchy references, same bearer/team, shared request deadline; no recursive project sweep
policy.resource_semantics: metadata only, contents not downloaded; unsafe URL credentials omitted; unavailable/incomplete marked
policy.format: bounded readable HTML and supported Tiptap JSON projections; valid Unicode; preserve explicit empty versus unavailable documents
policy.followup_reads: one canonical history read, no additional legacy thread-list read
policy.permissions: no caller permission widening or anonymous fallback
policy.freshness: legacy provider JSON/HTML and component snapshots have unconfirmed freshness; never claim Yjs revision or cross-document atomicity; do not overwrite a nonempty component snapshot with unversioned provider HTML
policy.response_delivery: Single provider turn by default; answer-only requests need no repository or tool checks; latest directive overrides historical intent gates; fetch additional context only when needed.
policy.graphql_metadata_endpoint: When a separate GraphQL endpoint is configured, bundle provider JSON/HTML in one viewer-bearer GraphQL request and file/link metadata in another per authorized component; an optional resource root error cannot discard a document read. Keep workspace/detail REST checks and shared deadline. No cross-principal cache, anonymous fallback, attachment download, or replay on GraphQL denial. REST-only deployments retain bounded JSON/HTML fallback.
policy.failure_observation: Finite operation/outcome/source/duration trace fields distinguish missing/null/empty/invalid/budget/denied/unavailable; no upstream original, document identity, body, URL or token in observations.
policy.related_meeting_bodies: RIID-5900 captures only directly linked, same-team, undeleted meeting bodies under the requester bearer and shared deadline. At most 20 meetings, 4 concurrent reads, 8192 UTF-8 bytes per body; all stored bodies participate in the existing 256KiB snapshot bound and 24h terminal retention. Base/resources/prompt remain title-only; explicit meeting view alone serves and records a body read. Empty, denied, deleted and unavailable remain distinct. Viewer audit visibility rechecks current body access. Board, meeting comments and further linked-work reads remain unimplemented.

limits: does not guarantee model comprehension or semantic completion
external attachment and linked URL bodies are not fetched by the server

loop.observation: Assignments carried parent titles and one previous message but not bounded parent documents or conversation evidence.
loop.hypothesis: Readable, scoped, bounded context can preserve the task goal while keeping the latest user directive authoritative.
loop.execute: Run synthetic task-context, permission/deadline, conversation-isolation and provider-placement regressions; verify this direct SSOT through knowledgecoverage in CI.
loop.evaluate: Test success, context budgets, resource metadata-only semantics, authorization identity and generated knowledge coverage must pass; live model comprehension is not inferred.
loop.retrospective: Keep inaccessible/truncated inputs explicit and preserve native session/workspace authority; expand context only from authorized references.

execution_status_boundary.persistence: assignment event projection stores bounded context per assignment/thread; cold history and SSE preserve it
execution_status_boundary.privacy: no absolute path/verification argv or credentials in execution_context
execution_status_boundary.legacy: missing context is unknown; never infer passed verification or permit replay
